prep_ai.description: A full-stack interview prep platform with 7,475 deduplicated questions from 130+ companies, AI answers in three styles, and company and domain filters.

MentiChat.description: A Flask-based RAG mentor grounded in 1,000+ NCERT document chunks to give students useful answers with fewer hallucinations.

C-Shell.description: A Unix shell built from scratch in C with fork, execvp, and waitpid, plus a REPL loop and 10+ built-in commands.

interview_data_pipeline.description: An end-to-end PySpark ETL pipeline that validates and deduplicates interview data, stores curated Parquet in S3, and supports Glue and Athena analytics.
